name: theme-mode-order
description: The client projection of the themeMode total order since ggui#987 (D4 = A, 'follow the widget'): with a stamped mode and a host announce present, the HOST wins — the embedding host owns runtime mode; the stamp and the sidecar are defaults. Before #987 this case expected 'light' (the stamp); it was promoted into the kit at that version and FAILED when the order flipped — the VERSION-POLICY §1.1 receipt that names the flip breaking.
